note: Lee County SC's GIS viewer (LeeGIS, Experience 3aa9a4d5...) and its ArcGIS Online org (services5.arcgis.com/zg6ovB2KKN8L0zFv) publish parcels, roads, flood, soils, municipal boundaries and addresses, but no zoning district layer; the county's mapping page says zoning maps are online but no queryable zoning service is linked.
